cards.text: Samuel, the LORD's prophet, has just anointed young David, and the Spirit of the LORD rushed upon David from that day forward (1 Samuel 16:13). Now we head over to Saul, king of Israel, and the Spirit of the LORD departs from him. Then something else begins to torment him, friend.

cards.question: Once the Spirit of the LORD departs from King Saul, what begins to torment him?

answers.text: A spirit of distress from the LORD
A sickness sent by his enemies

cards.question: A spirit of distress is tormenting King Saul. Who speaks up and tells Saul about it?

cards.text: Saul's servants have a plan: Saul should command them to seek out someone with one special skill. Whenever the spirit of distress is upon him, that person uses it, and Saul will be well.

cards.question: What skill are Saul's servants looking for?
Saul hears his servants' plan to find a harp player and turns it down. True or false?

cards.text: And one of Saul's servants already knows a guy. I bet he's been waiting for somebody to ask.

cards.question: One of Saul's servants says he has seen a son of ___ of Bethlehem who knows how to play the harp.

cards.text: Then the servant just keeps GOING: mighty man of valor, warrior, eloquent AND handsome. Friend, that's not a reference, that's a fan club.

cards.question: Last on the servant's list about Jesse's son: he says the ___ is with him.

cards.text: So Saul sends messengers to Jesse: "Send me your son David, who is with the sheep." The KING is calling a shepherd in from the field, like your CEO ringing your phone while you're out mowing the lawn.

cards.question: Jesse doesn't send David to the king empty-handed. What does he send to Saul along with him?

answers.text: Bread and wine and a young goat
Gold and silver and fine robes
Oil and honey and a calf

cards.text: David comes to Saul and enters his service. From watching sheep to working for the KING, friend.

cards.question: When David comes and enters Saul's service, Saul loves him very much. True or false?
Besides the harp, Saul gives David another job. David becomes Saul's ___.

cards.text: Then Saul sends word back to Jesse.

cards.question: What does Saul ask Jesse in his message?

answers.text: To let David stay in his service
To send his older sons as well
To come and live at the palace

cards.text: And Saul's reason: "for I am pleased with him." Friend, I spent YEARS in a junk drawer waiting for anybody to say that about me.

cards.question: Whenever the spirit from God comes upon Saul, David picks up his harp and plays. When he does, Saul's distress only gets worse. True or false?

cards.text: That's where we'll leave it for now, friend, because this story is only just going into the oven.
